notes.title: The Lost Recipes will release on August 28th
notes.notes:
Hello little goblins,
Let's head back into adventuring and numismatics! The Lost Recipes, a much easier stand-alone expansion for the Goblin and Coins II, will release on August 28th on Steam.

What can you expect?


         25 handcrafted levels (that get a bit challenging close to the end, but are a walk in the park compared to the most of GnC2 maze-like levels)
         Familiar mechanics, traps and enemies - but improved!
         Unlimited continues / level restarts
         No boss fights, just platforming
         Double-jump available from the very start of the game
         5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare, and post your artwork to the game hub
         Locked chests, shortcut portals and secret areas 
         Affordable price 
         Doesn't require you to play any previous game 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Added D-input support for Windows. This should enable users with older/generic controllers to use them in the game. 

Please note that buttons might be mapped differently than on x-input controllers and you might have to enable analogue mode (or try other things) in order to use your controller. 

If you encounter any troubles, please report in the community forums and remember to mention what version of the game you are using (for example, 1.0.4. Spanish) and what kind of controller (x-input or d-input).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Fixed a visibility issue with old school difficulty only bean cauldrons in Spanish and Russian version of the game. 

Patch 1.0.3 added new bean soup cauldrons to certain levels that were supposed to be visible only in old school difficulty. Due to a minor bug they were visible - but not allowed for picking up - to casual players using Spanish or Russian version of the game. This should be fixed now and these cauldrons will not be visible and will not confuse the players anymore.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Changelog
notes.notes:
- Fixed: Magic cast by wizards now respects the invulnerability state
- Changed: New bean soup cauldrons (life/hp) added for old school difficulty

New cauldrons can be found in levels 1-5, 2-3, 2-6, 3-1, 3-4, 3-6, 4-1, 4-5, 4-7, 5-1 and 5-4.

Please note:

If you encounter any technical difficulties that were not present in the previous build, or you want the old difficulty setting without additional cauldrons, you might consider downgrading - which is now an option. Just select the game in your Steam client, go to properties then betas tab, then select "downgrade - previous version". 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753431/cfaaf00419088afff1cc785e284c2419ba7259e9.png

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Spanish and Russian supported now!
notes.notes:
Hello goblins,
It's my pleasure to inform you that the game officially supports Russian and Spanish now. If you want to play in a language other than English, simply do this:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753431/1e494860fb664033c1427efcce84a765a802f7a4.png

Also, there's an additional challenge level for players who already finished the main story (you need to finish the story to unlock access to challenge levels).

Full price too expensive for you? Wishlist the game and be informed whenever it's on sale!
